companies.name: Forgeworks
companies.description: Production planning and execution software for discrete manufacturers. Connects the factory floor to scheduling, inventory, and quality control.
companies.customers: Mid-market manufacturers in aerospace, automotive, and industrial equipment. Used daily by production planners and plant managers.
companies.criticality: Sits at the center of daily production: schedules work orders, tracks materials, and coordinates quality checks. A loss of access would interrupt scheduling and shop-floor execution.
companies.concern: Customer concentration and the mix of recurring software revenue versus implementation services need validation.
